view: Frontal (PA/AP) chest radiograph, upright; L marker in image upper-right (patient's left) confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs on the right). Mild rotation (asymmetric medial clavicles, left hemithorax projected smaller). Scapulae partially overlie the upper lateral lung fields. Both costophrenic angles and lung apices included.

devices.location: Image upper-right corner, over the patient's left shoulder soft tissue

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined increased opacity in the left lower zone (retrocardiac/basal) with loss of the left hemidiaphragm outline and blunting of the left costophrenic angle; vascular crowding - suggests left lower lobe atelectasis or consolidation, possibly with a small pleural effusion
Elevated left hemidiaphragm (dome projects roughly 2 cm above the right), consistent with left basal volume loss
Prominent, unfolded/tortuous aortic knob with a bulging left upper mediastinal contour and a prominent left hilum (ectatic thoracic aorta likely; hilar mass not excluded)
Dense nodular/calcified opacities projecting over the right hilum, most consistent with calcified hilar lymph nodes
Mild leftward displacement of the cardiomediastinal silhouette (little cardiac shadow to the right of the spine), at least partly attributable to rotation; trachea remains near midline
Relative hyperlucency of the right lung with a larger right hemithorax (hyperinflation/compensatory or emphysematous change)
Degenerative changes of the cervicothoracic spine; no acute rib fracture or lytic lesion seen

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，輕度旋轉，肩胛骨部分重疊於肺野，吸氣深度尚可；未見任何管路、引流管、心律調節器或其他植入物，僅右上角可見L側標記。左下肺野可見邊界不清之增加密度影，左側橫膈輪廓模糊且位置上抬，左側肋膈角變鈍，疑左下葉肺塌陷（atelectasis）或實質化，不排除合併少量肋膜積液。主動脈弓突出且迂曲，左肺門較顯著；右肺門可見鈣化結節狀密度，疑為鈣化淋巴結。心臟大小在正常範圍，縱膈輕度左移（部分可歸因於旋轉），右肺相對過度透亮，頸胸椎有退化性變化，骨骼未見急性病灶。
